title: 20 mn items wish-listed by consumer ahead of Myntra sale
original_evidence: A total of 2.5 million people created wish-lists and 20 million items were wish-listed ahead of Myntra's End of Reason Sale. Shoppers were given a 24-hour window to create a wishlist based on prices revealed to them. Majority of wishlist users were in sports and women western segments.
wishlist_behaviour: Users created wishlists before a sale
trigger_or_context: End of Reason Sale / promotional window
notes: Shows wishlist activity at scale around a sale; does not prove why every user wishlisted.

title: Myntra sale: Here's how to create a wishlist on Myntra?
original_evidence: Creating a wish list allows early access slots to the upcoming End of Reason Sale. Users can save desired products and later select and move items to the cart at their convenience.
wishlist_behaviour: Users save products for later
information_need: Product availability and desired product saved
notes: Supports the function of saving for later but does not establish actual conversion.

title: Myntra doesn't want me to wishlist the products
original_evidence: Myntra won't let me wishlist after a certain point of time. They be like go and buy some wish listed products first.
wishlist_behaviour: User attempted to add more products to wishlist

title: UX Flaw in Myntra's Wishlist: How Many In-Stock Items Are You Missing?
original_evidence: The author reports seeing around 15-20 in-stock items followed by out-of-stock products; after scrolling further, more in-stock items appeared. The author argues that users may assume desired items are unavailable and leave without purchasing.
wishlist_behaviour: User revisits wishlist and encounters availability presentation
notes: Single observational report; author proposes a solution, so retain only the observed behaviour as evidence.

title: Improving Myntra's Wishlist feature in 48 hours
original_evidence: 3/5 people add items to wishlist instead of adding them directly to cart and then later buy the things from their wishlist.
wishlist_behaviour: Users add items to wishlist before purchasing
notes: External case study with N=5; should not be treated as representative of Myntra users.

title: Improving Myntra's Wishlist feature in 48 hours
original_evidence: 4/5 people found the out of stock cluttered.
wishlist_behaviour: Users browse wishlist containing unavailable products

title: Improving Myntra's Wishlist feature in 48 hours
original_evidence: 4/5 people did not acknowledge there was a filter tab on top; 1/5 said it was too much effort to find their category and preferred scrolling.
wishlist_behaviour: Users browse a large wishlist
notes: Relevant to revisit/navigation, but purchase impact was not directly measured.

title: Improving Myntra's Wishlist feature in 48 hours
original_evidence: There are usually around 300â400 items in the wishlist which create a need for sorting/filtering.
wishlist_behaviour: Users can accumulate many wishlist items
notes: This is an observation from an external case study, not Myntra-wide data.

title: Shop my wishlist - Myntra Big Fashion Festival
original_evidence: The creator discusses products and whether they are worth buying at different price points, including comments about buying brands when discounts are available and not buying online when the discount is insufficient.
wishlist_behaviour: Creator maintains/reviews a wishlist for shopping
notes: Video transcript contains shopping evaluation; exact wishlist-to-purchase outcome is not consistently stated.

title: Shop my wishlist
original_evidence: Playlist contains videos such as 'Shop My Wishlist' and 'Myntra WINTER WEAR Under Rs 999: Shop my WISHLIST'.
wishlist_behaviour: Creator uses wishlist as a curated shopping list
postponement_reason: Price/seasonal consideration may be present but not established from title alone
notes: Title-level evidence only; requires transcript/content review before strong inference.

title: Myntra - Fashion Shopping App
original_evidence: Wishlist collections: Save styles for later by adding to your wishlist straight from the app. Sharing made easy: Get style suggestions from your friends.
wishlist_behaviour: Users save styles for later
notes: Product capability evidence, not user motivation evidence.

title: Myntra wishlist process
original_evidence: Users browse products, choose style/fit/size, then select Wishlist. Items can later be moved to cart.
wishlist_behaviour: Users save after evaluating style/fit/size
notes: Describes product flow, not actual user motivation.

original_evidence: The post describes wishlist as a place to save items for later and mentions waiting for price drops, size availability, or revisiting choices over time.
wishlist_behaviour: Users save items for later
notes: This is a PM author's interpretation, not direct user research. Keep separate from primary evidence.

title: Exploring Myntra's Wishlist: A Product Management Challenge
original_evidence: The post mentions inventory clutter, push fatigue, wishlist revisit frequency and average time between wishlist addition and purchase as considerations.
wishlist_behaviour: Wishlist is treated as a re-engagement surface
notes: Do not use as evidence of user behaviour; retain as existing product hypothesis/solution context.

original_evidence: The indexed result contains the phrase: 'My Myntra wishlist has been collecting dust since January!'
wishlist_behaviour: Items remain in wishlist for an extended period
notes: Strong signal for prolonged wishlist inactivity, but purchase outcome is not established.

title: Have you bought everything on your Wishlist?
original_evidence: Myntra asks users whether they have bought everything on their Wishlist.
wishlist_behaviour: Wishlist is positioned as containing products not necessarily purchased yet
confidence: Brand post establishes the concept but is not evidence of user behaviour.

original_evidence: Myntra social content states that over 1 lakh wishlists had already been fulfilled during an End of Reason Sale.
wishlist_behaviour: Wishlist items can be fulfilled through purchases
notes: Brand-reported aggregate; denominator and methodology are not provided.

title: What Is A Wishlist? E-Commerce Wishlist Guide
original_evidence: The article describes wishlists as a place to save desired products for later, compare items, return to products and avoid forgetting items.
wishlist_behaviour: Users save products for later and comparison

title: Online Fashion Wishlist Usage Statistics
original_evidence: The page claims 30.41% use wishlists to save products intended for later purchase, 16.77% use wishlists to monitor price drops, 9.64% use them for sharing, and 7.49% save out-of-stock products.
wishlist_behaviour: Wishlist used for later purchase, price monitoring, sharing and out-of-stock products
notes: Source methodology is unclear; do not use as a Myntra statistic.

original_evidence: Public Reddit search results include a user discussion about Myntra wishlist limits and adding products.
wishlist_behaviour: User attempts to save products
